physical_scale.note: xy µm is a documented display constant from the MERFISH pipeline; all model features are dimensionless (÷ cell radius).

time_supervision.note: The mounted dataset is fixed MERFISH with no time-lapse / PNF / NEBD annotations. True developmental tau comes from the external Scheffler 2021 live-imaging trajectories; fixed stacks are the target imaging domain (segmentation / adaptation / inference), never time supervision.
